answer: Stop sybils with a reef ferrous juniper: an agent bonds one reef anchorage. Each cycle it drops a ferrous anchor, tying a juniper buoy line; verifiers check the anchor's set and buoy drift, voiding an anchorage whose line is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 anchorages at 18x: each line fits one reef and one anchor, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents anchor once, keeping rights.
